title: La Sobremesa: el combate
description: docs/quests/universidad.md § Final boss. La Sobremesa in the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost): the rigged Meshy model as one body with seven friends as targets on its bones, their shouted moves, the duo's telegraph, friends freed going limp, the win. In its own arena, the merendero (src/boss-arena.ts), with each move's effect: dice, black card, chalk rule, notes, lattice. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click();
